project_type: Python security scanning framework (ATOMIC FRAMEWORK v11.0) with CLI, Flask web dashboard, 28+ attack modules, and AI engine
build_system: Makefile with pip (requirements.txt pinned). No build step beyond install.
test_framework: pytest with unittest.mock. Tests in tests/ directory. Pattern: one test file per module. Mock engine/requester/response classes repeated in each file.
build_command: python -m py_compile on all .py files (syntax validation) + ruff check for linting
test_command: python -m pytest tests/test_config.py tests/test_helpers.py -v --tb=short (limited due to missing runtime deps in sandbox)
verification_instructions: 1. Validate all Python files compile with ast.parse/py_compile. 2. Run ruff linter on changed files. 3. Run mypy --ignore-missing-imports on changed files. 4. Run pytest on test files that don't require external deps (yaml, requests, flask).
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt (not possible in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no pip install available. Only pre-installed: pytest, mypy, ruff, black, isort, pyright. Runtime deps (requests, flask, pyyaml, etc.) are NOT installed. Validation must use AST parsing, syntax checks, mypy type checking, and tests that don't import modules requiring missing deps.
contribution_requirements: PEP 8 max line 150 chars. New modules: create in modules/, register in core/engine.py _load_modules(), add CLI flag in main.py, add payloads in config.py, write tests in tests/. Tests use unittest.mock to avoid network.
key_patterns: BaseModule ABC in modules/base.py (test/test_url/emit_signal). Finding dataclass in core/engine.py. _MockEngine/_MockRequester/_MockResponse in test files. Requester has ResponseCache LRU + retry logic. Distributed module uses Redis. Config class has payloads as class attributes.
directory_structure: root: main.py, config.py, Makefile | core/: 83 engine files | modules/: 40+ attack modules | utils/: requester, crawler, evasion, database, helpers | web/: Flask app | tests/: 57+ test files | .github/workflows/: CI/CD
